name: Gisela
beschreibung:
Conveniently located near Kufstein central railway station, the established Hotel Gisela welcomes business travellers and holidaymakers with bright rooms and friendly attention.

The historic Kufstein Fortress, picturesque Roemerhofgasse, and the Inn river path are just a short walk away.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gisela in Kufstein offers central city comfort and Tyrolean charm near the train station and fortress.
